attributes.name: Invigorating Temple Sword +2
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength, Dexterity, or Melee skill + 1d8+2; you may additionally recharge a blessing to add your Dexterity die. If you do not have the Monk trait, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

When a character at your location defeats a monster, you may recharge this card to recharge a random card from your discard pile.
